attchmntText: Bondada Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Bondada Engineering Limited filed a corporate presentation for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of INR 14,153.6 Mn, an increase of 16% year-on-year. EBITDA grew 12% to INR 1,622.2 Mn, and net profit rose 18% to INR 1,114.0 Mn. The order book stood at approximately INR 104,458 Mn as on October 31, 2026. The company announced the migration of its equity shares from the BSE SME platform to the Main Boards of NSE and BSE. Credit rating was upgraded to CRISIL A+/Stable. Bank facilities were enhanced from INR 8,000 Mn to INR 20,000 Mn. The presentation is available on the company website www.bondada.net.

attchmntText: Bondada Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bondada Engineering Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The Board also received the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors. The Board meeting took place on 12th November 2026 at 11:30 AM at the Corporate Office in Hyderabad. The session concluded at 3.25 PM. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulations 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations. The information is available on the company website at www.bondada.net. Dr. Sonia Bidlan, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Bondada Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Other Restructuring
voiceSummary: Bondada Engineering Limited incorporated Bondada International FZ-LLC in the Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone, United Arab Emirates, as a wholly owned subsidiary. The company subscribed to 20 equity shares with a face value of AED 1,000 each, aggregating to AED 20,000. This acquisition represents 100% of the paid-up equity share capital. The new entity serves as an overseas holding structure for international business operations. It targets sectors including renewable energy, Battery Energy Storage Systems, telecom, and power infrastructure. All required regulatory and governmental approvals have been obtained. The transaction is not classified as a related party transaction. This move supports the company's strategy to expand its global presence and pursue international business opportunities.

voiceSummary: Bondada Engineering Limited will hold an investors and analysts conference call on Friday, 13th Nov, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST. The event will discuss the operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1FY27. The meeting will take place via audio conferencing. No unpublished price sensitive information will be discussed. The company is Bondada Engineering Limited. The symbol on the NSE is BONDADA. The scrip code on the BSE is 543971. Management representatives include Dr. Raghavendra Rao Bondada, Rear Admiral Sreenivas Ratnam, and CA Satyanarayana Baratam. Contact persons are Rushabh Shah and Pratham Chaturvedi. The call is subject to last-minute changes.
